messages.subject: Error in Model Specification?
parts:
Hi all,

I was wondering if I could get some help with this. I am trying to run a MTMM model. After I set the model and try using either the sem() or cfa(), the output will display an debug message. While the model will run and I can see the results using the summary(), I can't extract the factor scores using the predict(). I am not sure what is happening but some guidance would be greatly appreciated! I would really like to fix the problem because the end goal is to try and extract the factor scores.


model3r <- 
  "Relationship_Building =~ RB1bScored + RB1cScored + RB1dScored + RB2aScored + RB2cScored + RB2dScored + RB3aScored + RB3bScored +          RB4dScored;
Achieving_Results  =~  AR1aScored +  AR2bScored + AR2cScored +AR2dScored + AR3bScored + AR3cScored + AR4aScored + AR4bScored + AR4cScored;
Analytical_Thinking = ~  AT2aScored + AT2cScored + AT3aScored +  AT4aScored + AT4bScored + AT4cScored ;
Planning_Organising =~ PO1cScored +  PO2bScored + PO2cScored + PO2dScored + PO3aScored + PO4aScored;

RB1bScored ~~ RB1cScored;
RB2aScored ~~ RB2cScored;
RB3aScored ~~ RB3bScored;
AR2bScored ~~ AR2dScored;
AR4bScored ~~ AR4cScored;
 AT4aScored ~~ AT4bScored;
PO2bScored ~~ PO2dScored;
PO2bScored ~~ PO2dScored
"

modelcfa3r <- sem(model=model3r, orthogonal=F, std.lv=T, data=SJT)
summary(modelcfa3r, standardized=T, modindices = F, fit.measures=T)
inspect(modelcfa3r, "cov.lv")
predict(modalcfa3r)
